scoring_instructions.binary: 0 or 1, where 0 means the criterion is not met and 1 means it is met
scoring_instructions.five: 0 to 5, where 0 means not met and 5 means fully met
scoring_instructions.percent: 0 to 100, where the value is the percent of criterion fulfillment

overall_instructions.exclude: Do not include an overall_conclusion field.

review_instructions.include: Include a review field with a concise review from this criterion perspective.
review_instructions.exclude: Do not include a review field for this criterion.

schema_descriptions.criteria_recommendations: 1-3 specific recommendations for this criterion based on the score
schema_descriptions.total_score: Overall score as the average of all criteria scores
schema_descriptions.aggregated_recommendations: Aggregated list of unique recommendations from all criteria
schema_descriptions.criterion_review: Detailed review of this criterion from the analyzed perspective.
